ItemID: NA; Title: Through the Eyes Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Flaw's heavy, melodic sound fits my recent interest in Disturbed and heavier rock; I'd try this now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Something Like Human; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Fuel's melodic hard rock fits the side of my listening represented by One Day Remains; I'd choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Load; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its hard rock direction interests me, but other picks feel closer to the heavier sound I want today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Panic; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I can't identify this album confidently from the title, so I don't have enough reason to choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Master of Puppets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its intense riffs and extended arrangements appeal to the interests suggested by my In Flames and Tool listening; I'd choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: The End of All Things to Come Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Mudvayne's heavy grooves and intricate rhythms fit my current interest in Ten Thousand Fists and 10.000 Days; I'd choose this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lines In My Face; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title doesn't give me a clear enough connection to my current listening to pursue it today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Three Days Grace; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic heaviness fits my rock listening, but I'm prioritizing more rhythmically intricate music this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Kill Em All; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The aggressive metal sound fits, but I'd pick Master of Puppets first for its more developed arrangements.
ItemID: NA; Title: Dirt Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its dark, heavy rock sound appeals to me, but I've already picked the albums I most want to explore today.
